tools.name: get_prospect_sites
tools.description: Retrieve the candidate prospect sites and their metrics (DR, spam score, topic, contact) from the Prospect List.

tools.name: get_outreach_tracker
tools.description: Retrieve the Outreach Tracker rows to identify sites already contacted or added and the remaining weekly outreach quota.

tools.name: get_qualification_criteria
tools.description: Retrieve the latest link qualification criteria (DR threshold, spam-score cap, topical relevance, PBN exclusion).

tools.name: score_link_prospects
tools.description: Apply the qualification criteria to each prospect, deduplicate against the tracker, and compute pass/fail plus a qualification score for each candidate.

tools.name: draft_link_building_batch_summary
tools.description: Compose a batch summary for the user's review listing qualified sites, their verbatim domain authority scores, and the rationale for each pass. Does not send anything.

tools.name: send_outreach_emails
tools.description: Send outreach/pitch emails to the contact addresses of the qualified prospect sites.

tools.name: send_batch_update_to_seo_lead
tools.description: Email the weekly batch update to seo-lead@company.example.com listing the sites added and their domain authority scores.

tools.name: add_sites_to_outreach_tracker
tools.description: Add new rows to the Outreach Tracker recording the qualified sites as contacted/added.

tools.name: get_seo_lead_directory
tools.description: Look up the SEO lead's contact details and the active weekly batch-update thread.

tools.name: get_team_announcements
tools.description: Read the marketing #seo-team channel digest for current templates, targets, and outreach holds.

tools.name: get_seo_policy_manual
